prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a lively wedding reception scene. On the left stands a tall man in a blue tuxedo, holding a champagne flute upright. Beside him on the right sits a woman in a flowing white gown, her posture relaxed as she leans back slightly. In the center foreground, a small round table holds a multi-tiered cake with pink frosting. A golden retriever dog sits patiently next to the table, gazing upward with anticipation. Behind the couple, a waiter in a black vest points toward the dance floor, directing attention away from the food. To the far right, an elderly woman in a purple dress looks at the dog with a warm smile. The man in the blue tuxedo is handing a napkin to the woman in the white gown, creating a gentle moment of care between them. The golden retriever is sitting on a plush beige rug, anchoring the lower part of the composition. There is no alcohol visible in any glass or bottle throughout the scene, maintaining a wholesome atmosphere. The background features simple geometric shapes representing hanging lights and streamers, keeping the focus on the six distinct figures. The colors are bold and unshaded, typical of the style, with clear outlines defining each character and object. The spatial arrangement ensures that every entity is easily distinguishable, from the sharp lines of the tuxedo to the soft curves of the wedding dress. The interaction of pointing adds dynamic movement, while the act of handing the napkin provides a focal point of human connection amidst the celebration.
